about_the_game:
Tormans is a space sandbox in an open world — survival with RPG elements set in a far-future post-technological universe. You are one of the last survivors after the collapse of a highly advanced galactic civilization, now scattered among the stars.

Do absolutely anything you want: travel to any inhabited world or dead planet, become a free artifact hunter, space pirate, relic smuggler, wanderer among abandoned megastructures and ruins of ancient civilizations. Recruit a crew, gather followers, raid caravans and enemy outposts, salvage the rarest artifacts of forgotten eras and resources from the wrecks of dead fleets.

Write your own story in this merciless cosmos: uncover what exactly caused the fall of the galactic civilization, why the stars have gone silent, and why entire sectors have turned into lifeless voids. A huge procedurally generated sector roughly 1220 light-years across, hundreds of star systems, dangerous anomalies, derelict stations, barren planets and mysterious artifacts are waiting for you.
